title: C4OS Grill Question 035 - Chat Debug Visibility

questions.label: Should Chat Debug be enabled by default?
questions.help: Recommended: disabled by default and developer-oriented. It can be enabled as a plugin when needed.
options: Enabled by default in development builds only
Enabled by default for all users

questions.label: What should Chat Debug show?
questions.help: Recommended: current chat session live and historical tool events, with sensitive parameters redacted.
options: Current chat session live and historical tool events with redaction

questions.help: Clarify export logs, approval decisions, tool parameters, app tool calls, sensitive redaction, or whether normal users should ever see this.
